enhancements.description: T'AU EMPIRE model only. Select one plasma rifle equipped by the bearer. Improve the Strength characteristic of that weapon by 2, and improve the Attacks, Armour Penetration and Damage characteristics of that weapon by 1.

enhancements.name: Fusion Blades
enhancements.description: T'AU EMPIRE model only. Select one fusion blaster equipped by the bearer. Improve the Attacks characteristic of that weapon by 1, improve the Strength characteristic of that weapon by 3, and that weapon has the [MELTA 4] ability.

rules.name: Patient Hunter
rules.description: During the third, fourth, and fifth battle rounds, ranged weapons equipped by T'au Empire models from your army have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability. During the third, fourth and fifth battle rounds, while a unit is a Guided unit (see For the Greater Good), each time a ranged attack is made by a model in that unit that targets a Spotted unit, you can ignore any or all modifiers to that attack's Ballistic skill characteristics and/or all modifiers to the Hit roll.

enhancements.name: Exemplar of the Kauyon
enhancements.description: T'AU EMPIRE model only (excluding Kroot Shaper models). While the bearer is leading a unit, the Patient Hunter Detachment rule applies to that unit from the second battle round onwards instead of from the third.

enhancements.name: Precision of the Patient Hunter
enhancements.description: T'AU EMPIRE model only. Each time the bearer makes a ranged attack, add 1 to the Hit roll. From the third battle round onwards, add 1 to the Wound roll as well.

enhancements.name: Solid-image Projection Unit
enhancements.description: T'AU EMPIRE model only. After both players have deployed their armies, select up to three T'AU EMPIRE units from your army and redeploy them. When doing so, you can set those units up in Strategic Reserves if you wish, regardless of how many units are already in Strategic Reserves.

enhancements.name: Through Unity, Devastation
enhancements.description: T'AU EMPIRE model only (excluding Kroot Shaper models). While the bearer is leading a unit, each time that unit is an Observer unit, until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in a Guided unit have the [LETHAL HITS] ability while targeting their Spotted unit.

rules.name: Hunter's Instincts
rules.description: Each time a Kroot model from your army makes an attack, add 1 to the Hit roll if the target of that attack is below its Starting Strength, and add 1 to the Wound roll as well if the target of that attack is Below Half-strength.

rules.name: Skirmish Fighters
rules.description: Kroot models from your army have a 6+ invulnerable save against melee attacks and a 5+ invulnerable save against ranged attacks.

enhancements.name: Borthrod Gland
enhancements.description: Kroot Flesh Shaper only. While the bearer is leading a unit, each time a model in that unit makes a melee attack, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.

enhancements.name: Kroothawk Flock
enhancements.description: Kroot model only. Ranged weapons equipped by models in the bearer's unit have the [IGNORES COVER] ability, and enemy units that are set up on the battlefield as Reinforcements cannot be set up within 12" horizontally of the bearer.

enhancements.name: Nomadic Hunter
enhancements.description: Kroot Trail Shaper model only. While the bearer is leading a unit, add 3" to the Move characteristic of models in that unit and ranged weapons equipped by models in that unit have the [ASSAULT] ability.

enhancements.name: Root-carved Weapons
enhancements.description: Kroot War Shaper model only. All weapons equipped by the bearer have the [PRECISION] and [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] abilities.

rules.name: Guerrilla Ambushers
rules.description: Each time an enemy unit is selected to fire Overwatch, roll one D6: on a 4+, until the end of the turn, that unit cannot make Overwatch attacks that target Kroot units from your army.

rules.name: Forming Boarding Squads
rules.description: In the Form Boarding Squads step, a Kroot Farstalkers unit is split into two Boarding Squads, each containing 6 models.

rules.name: Mustering A Boarding Patrol
rules.description:
You can include up to two of the following units (duplicates are not allowed):
- Kroot Flesh Shaper
- Kroot Trail Shaper
- Kroot War Shaper

You can include up to three of the following unit:
- Kroot Carnivores (10 models)

For each Kroot Carnivores unit you include, you can include up to one of each of the following units:
- Kroot Farstalkers (12 models)
- Kroot Hounds (5 models)
- Krootox Riders (1 model)

rules.name: Rules Adaptions
rules.description:
- Kroot Carnivores units can perform the Secure Site Tactical Manoeuvre as if they had the Battleline keyword.
- Each time you set up a Kroot Carnivores unit in an Entry Zone, you can set up a Kroot Hounds unit and/or a Krootox Riders unit in that same Entry Zone.
- If a Kroot Carnivores or Kroot Farstalkers unit from your army destroys an enemy unit while receiving the benefits of the Kroot Flesh Shaper's Rites of Feasting ability, the Feel No Pain 5+ ability they gain stays in effect, even after they stop receiving the benefit of that ability.
- The Kroot Carnivores unit loses the Fieldcraft ability.
- The Kroot Hounds unit loses the Loping Pounce ability.
- The Krootox Riders unit loses the Kroot Packmates ability.

rules.name: Void Combat Discipline
rules.description:
Units from your army with the For the Greater Good ability lose that ability and T'au Empire units from your army gain this one.

Each time a model in this unit makes a ranged attack, it can ignore other models in this unit for the purposes of determining visibility. In addition, this unit is eligible to perform the Set Overwatch Tactical Manoeuvre in a turn in which it Advanced or Fell Back.

enhancements.name: Experienced Leader
enhancements.description: At the start of the first battle round, select one enemy unit on the battlefield. Until the end of the battle, each time a KROOT model from your army makes an attack that targets that enemy unit, if the bearer is on the battlefield, you can re-roll the Wound roll.

enhancements.name: Quill Marker
enhancements.description: At the start of your Charge phase, select one enemy unit within 12" of the bearer. Until the end of the phase, each time a KROOT unit from your army declares a charge, if it is within 6" of that enemy unit, it can include that enemy unit as a target of that charge, even if it is not visible to it.

rules.name: Killing Blow
rules.description: During the first, second and third battle rounds, ranged weapons equipped by T'au Empire models from your army have the [ASSAULT] ability. During the first, second and third battle rounds, while a unit is a Guided unit (see For the Greater Good), its ranged weapons have the [LETHAL HITS] ability.

enhancements.name: Coordinated Exploitation
enhancements.description: T'AU EMPIRE model only (excluding Kroot Shaper models). While the bearer is leading a unit, each time that unit is an Observer unit, until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in a Guided unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability while targeting their Spotted unit.

enhancements.name: Exemplar of the Mont'ka
enhancements.description: T'AU EMPIRE model only (excluding Kroot Shaper models). While the bearer is leading a unit, the Killing Blow Detachment rule applies to that unit during the fourth battle round as well.

enhancements.name: Strategic Conqueror
enhancements.description: T'AU EMPIRE model only. At the start of the first battle round, before the first turn begins, select one objective marker on the battlefield. While a friendly T'AU EMPIRE model is within range of that objective marker and the bearer is on the battlefield, add 1 to that friendly model's Objective Control characteristic.

enhancements.name: Strike Swiftly
enhancements.description: T'AU EMPIRE model only. At the start of the battle, before any moves are made using the Scouts ability, you can select up to two friendly T'AU EMPIRE units within 6" of the bearer that do not have the Scouts ability. Until the end of the battle, all models in the selected units have the Scouts 6" ability.

rules.name: Bonded Heroes
rules.description: Each time a T'au Empire Battlesuit model from your army makes a ranged attack that targets a unit within 12", improve the Strength characteristic of that attack by 1. If that attack targets a unit within 9", improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1 as well.

enhancements.name: Internal Grenade Racks
enhancements.description: T'au Empire Battlesuit model only. The bearer has the Grenades keyword, and each time the bearer ends a Normal move, you can select one enemy unit that it moved over during that move. If you do, roll six D6: for each 4+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound.

enhancements.name: Prototype Weapon System
enhancements.description: T'au Empire Battlesuit model only. Each time the bearer is selected to shoot, select either the [LETHAL HITS] or [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability. Until those attacks are resolved, ranged weapons equipped by the bearer have the selected ability.

enhancements.name: Puretide Engram Neurochip
enhancements.description: T'au Empire Battlesuit model only. Each time you target the bearer's unit with a Stratagem, roll one D6: on a 4+, you gain 1CP.

enhancements.name: Starflare Ignition System
enhancements.description: T'au Empire Battlesuit model only. At the end of your opponent's turn, if the bearer's unit is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, you can remove that unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.

rules.name: Rules Adaptions
rules.description:
- Rules that refer to Observer, Guided and/or Spotted units have no effect.
- Crisis Battlesuits units lose the Deep Strike ability.
- The Kroot Carnivores unit loses the Fieldcraft ability.
- The Stealth Battlesuits unit loses the Homing Beacon ability.
- The Vespid Stingwings unit loses the Deep Strike and Airborne Agility abilities.

rules.name: Mustering A Boarding Patrol
rules.description:
You can include up to two of the following units (duplicates are not allowed):
- Cadre Fireblade
- Darkstrider
- Ethereal

You can include up to three of each of the following units:
- Breacher Team (10 models)
- Pathfinder Team (5 or 10 models)
- Strike Team (10 models)

You can include up to one of each of the following units:
- Kroot Carnivores (10 models)
- Stealth Battlesuits (3 models)
- Vespid Stingwings (5 models)

You can include up to one of the following units:
- Crisis Fireknife Battlesuits (3 models)
- Crisis Starscythe Battlesuits (3 models)
- Crisis Sunforge Battlesuits (3 models)

rules.name: Forming Boarding Squads
rules.description: Fire Warrior units that do not contain a Fire Warrior Shas'ui or Breacher Fire Warrior Shas'ui model after you have Boarding Squads lose the Markerlight keyword.

rules.name: Markerlight Precision
rules.description: Each time a T'au Empire unit from your army (excluding Kroot units) is selected to shoot, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have their Ballistic Skill characteristic improved by 1 and have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability while targeting an enemy unit that is visible to one or more friendly Markerlight units that are not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy models.

rules.name: Void Combat Discipline
rules.description:
Units from your army with the For the Greater Good ability lose that ability and T'au Empire units from your army gain this one.

Each time a model in this unit makes a ranged attack, it can ignore other models in this unit for the purposes of determining visibility. In addition, this unit is eligible to perform the Set Overwatch Tactical Manoeuvre in a turn in which it Advanced or Fell Back.

enhancements.name: Target Optimisation Microdrones
enhancements.description: CADRE FiREbLADE model only. Once per turn, in your Shooting phase, when a friendly FiRE WARRiOR, PATHFiNDER TEAM or CADRE FIREBLADE unit within 6" of the bearer is selected to shoot, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, until the end of the phase, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of ranged weapons equipped by models in that unit by 1.

enhancements.name: Duty's Echo
enhancements.description: ETHEREAL model only. At the end of your Shooting phase, you can select one friendly FiRE WARRiOR or PATHFiNDER TEAM unit within 6" of the bearer. If you do, that unit can make a Normal move of up to 3" and then counts as having performed the Set Overwatch Tactical Manoeuvre this turn.

stratagems.name: COMMAND RE-ROLL
stratagems.when: Any phase, just after you make an Advance roll, a Charge roll, a Desperate Escape test or a Hazardous test for a unit from your army, or a Hit roll, a Wound roll, a Damage roll or a saving throw for a model in that unit, or a roll to determine the number of attacks made with a weapon equipped by a model in that unit. If you are using fast dice rolling, this Stratagem can still be used after rolling multiple rolls or saving throws at once.
stratagems.target: That unit or model from your army.
stratagems.effect: You re-roll that roll, test or saving throw. If you are using fast dice rolling, select one of those rolls or saving throws to re-roll.
stratagems.legend: A great commander can bend even the vagaries of fate and fortune to their will, the better to ensure victory.

stratagems.name: GO TO GROUND
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One INFANTRY unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, all models in your unit have a 6+ invulnerable save and have the Benefit of Cover.
stratagems.legend: Seeking salvation from incoming fire, warriors hurl themselves into whatever cover they can find.

stratagems.name: INSANE BRAVERY
stratagems.when: Battle-shock step of your Command phase, just before you take a Battle-shock test for a unit from your army.
stratagems.target: That unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Your unit automatically passes that Battle-shock test.
stratagems.restrictions: You cannot use this Stratagem more than once per battle.
stratagems.legend: Indifferent to their own survival, these warriors hold their ground against seemingly impossible odds.

stratagems.name: EPIC CHALLENGE
stratagems.when: Fight phase, when a CHARACTER unit from your army that is within Engagement Range of one or more Attached units is selected to fight.
stratagems.target: One CHARACTER model in your unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, all melee attacks made by that model have the [PRECISION] ability.
stratagems.legend: The legends of the 41st Millennium are replete with deadly duels between mighty champions.

stratagems.name: HEROIC INTERVENTION
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Charge phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Charge move.
stratagems.target: One unit from your army that is within 6" of that enemy unit and would be eligible to declare a charge against that enemy unit if it were your Charge phase.
stratagems.effect: Your unit now declares a charge that targets only that enemy unit, and you resolve that charge as if it were your Charge phase.
stratagems.restrictions: You can only select a VEHICLE unit from your army if it is a WALKER. Note that even if this charge is successful, your unit does not receive any Charge bonus this turn.
stratagems.legend: Voices raised in furious war cries, your warriors surge forth to meet the enemy's onslaught head-on.

stratagems.name: COUNTER-OFFENSIVE
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has fought.
stratagems.target: One unit from your army that is within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units and that has not already been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Your unit fights next.
stratagems.legend: In close-quarters combat, the slightest hesitation can leave an opening for a swift foe to exploit.

stratagems.name: TANK SHOCK
stratagems.when: Your Charge phase, just after a VEHICLE unit from your army ends a Charge move.
stratagems.target: That VEHICLE unit.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit within Engagement Range of your unit, and select one VEHICLE model in your unit that is within Engagement Range of that enemy unit. Roll a number of D6 equal to the Toughness characteristic of the selected VEHICLE model. For each 5+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound (to a maximum of 6 mortal wounds).
stratagems.legend: Ramming the foe with a speeding vehicle may be an unsubtle tactic, but it is a murderously effective one.

stratagems.name: RAPID INGRESS
stratagems.when: End of your opponent's Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One unit from your army that is in Reserves.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can arrive on the battlefield as if it were the Reinforcements step of your Movement phase, and if every model in that unit has the Deep Strike ability, you can set that unit up as described in the Deep Strike ability (even though it is not your Movement phase).
stratagems.restrictions: You cannot use this Stratagem to enable a unit to arrive on the battlefield during a battle round it would not normally be able to do so in.
stratagems.legend: Be it cunning strategy, potent technology or supernatural ritual, there are many means by which a commander may hasten their warriors' onset.

stratagems.name: FIRE OVERWATCH
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Movement or Charge phase, just after an enemy unit is set up or when an enemy unit starts or ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move, or declares a charge.
stratagems.target: One unit from your army that is within 24" of that enemy unit and that would be eligible to shoot if it were your Shooting phase.
stratagems.effect: If that enemy unit is visible to your unit, your unit can shoot that enemy unit as if it were your Shooting phase.
stratagems.restrictions: You cannot target a TITANIC unit with this Stratagem. Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a ranged attack, an unmodified Hit roll of 6 is required to score a hit, irrespective of the attacking weapon's Ballistic Skill or any modifiers. You can only use this Stratagem once per turn.
stratagems.legend: A hail of wildfire can drive back advancing foes.

stratagems.name: GRENADE
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One GRENADES unit from your army (excluding units that Advanced, Fell Back or have shot this turn) that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.effect: Select one GRENADES model in your unit and one enemy unit that is not within Engagement Range of any units from your army and is within 8" of and visible to your GRENADES model. Roll six D6: for each 4+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound.
stratagems.legend: Priming their hand-held projectiles, these warriors draw back and hurl death into the enemy's midst.

stratagems.name: SMOKESCREEN
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One SMOKE unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, all models in your unit have the Benefit of Cover and the Stealth ability.
stratagems.legend: Even the most skilled marksmen struggle to hit targets veiled by billowing screens of smoke.

stratagems.name: NEW ORDERS
stratagems.when: End of your Command phase.
stratagems.target: One of your active Secondary Mission cards.
stratagems.effect: Discard it and draw one new Secondary Mission card.
stratagems.legend: High command has received new intelligence.

stratagems.name: MULTISENSORY SCANNING
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One T'AU EMPIRE unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, re-roll a Wound roll of 1. If it is a Kroot or Vespid Stingwings unit, you can re-roll the Wound roll instead.
stratagems.legend: Target analysis data from scanning drones is rapidly translated into inputs ideally tailored to a range of alien sensoria and then disseminated through the cadre.

stratagems.name: ALIEN EXPERTISE
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One T'AU EMPIRE unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Advanced. If it is a Kroot or Vespid Stingwings unit, until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced as well.
stratagems.legend: There is much that the alien auxiliaries of the T'au empire can teach the Fire caste, not least through practical and deadly battlefield demonstrations.

stratagems.name: GUIDED FIRE
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One T'AU EMPIRE unit from your army (excluding Kroot and Vespid Stingwings units) that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Strength characteristic of ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit. If your unit is wholly within 9" of one or more KROOT or VESPID STINGWINGS units from your army, add 2 to the Strength characteristic of ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit instead.
stratagems.legend: These Fire Warriors employ sensory data fed to them by supporting alien auxiliary units to maximise accuracy and place their shots against weak points they might not have perceived.

stratagems.name: INTERLOCKING MANOUEVRES
stratagems.when: End of the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One T'AU EMPIRE unit from your army that was eligible to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: If your unit is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, it can make a Normal move of up to 6". Otherwise, your unit can make a Fall Back move. It cannot embark within a Transport at the end of this move if it disembarked from a TRANSPORT this turn.
stratagems.legend: Regular Fire caste forces operating as part of auxiliary cadres are well trained in swift repositioning and fighting retreats, the better to exploit the presence of or provide support for their alien comrades.

stratagems.name: PHEROMONE WAYPOINTS
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One Kroot or Vespid Stingwings unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit Advances, do not make an Advance roll for it. Instead, until the end of the phase, add 6" to the Move characteristic of models in your unit.
stratagems.legend: Air caste craft have dropped drones that emit pheromones into this region, their emissions invisible but blazing like beacons to the correct alien senses.

stratagems.name: EXPERIMENTAL MODIFICATIONS
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One Kroot or Vespid Stingwings unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of weapons equipped by models in your unit by 1.
stratagems.legend: These experimental Earth caste weapon upgrades can only activate for short bursts at a time, but the extra stopping power they provide is formidable.

stratagems.name: EXPERIMENTAL WEAPONRY
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One T'AU EMPIRE unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time you roll one or more dice to determine the number of attacks made with a weapon equipped by a model in your unit, you can re-roll the result.
stratagems.legend: T'au scientists have distributed the latest prototype weapons amongst this cadre's contingents, all optimised to increase reliability and accuracy.

stratagems.name: REACTIVE IMPACT DAMPENERS
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One T'au Empire Battlesuit unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, if the Strength characteristic of that attack is greater than the Toughness characteristic of your unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.
stratagems.legend: Advancements in battlesuit field technology include the addition of autoreactive shield dampers to absorb and dissipate the energy from high-velocity kinetic strikes.

stratagems.name: AUTOMATED REPAIR DRONES
stratagems.when: Command phase.
stratagems.target: One T'au Empire Battlesuit unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Select one BATTLESUIT model in your unit: that model regains up to D3+1 lost wounds.
stratagems.legend: Much research is being placed into deploying miniaturised drones to affect battlefield repairs and dispense emergency medical treatments in combat.

stratagems.name: NEUROWEB SYSTEM JAMMER
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One T'au Empire Crisis unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit can only be selected as the target of a ranged attack if the attacking model is within 18".
stratagems.legend: This prototype countermeasure device emits an intense neurostatic jamming field, scrambling the enemy's senses and fouling their aim.

stratagems.name: EXPERIMENTAL AMMUNITION
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One T'AU EMPIRE unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect:
Select one of the following to apply to your unit until the end of the phase:
Improve the Strength characteristic of ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit by 1.Improve the Strength and Armour Penetration characteristics of ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit by 1, and those weapons have the [HAZARDOUS] ability.
stratagems.restrictions: You cannot target the same unit with the Experimental Ammunition and Threat Assessment Analyser Stratagems in the same phase.
stratagems.legend: From hardened warheads and amplified ion capacitors, to hyperaccelerated pulse fields and refined fusion cores, the T'au are forever innovating improvements to improve the lethality of their ammunition.

stratagems.name: THREAT ASSESSMENT ANALYSER
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One T'AU EMPIRE unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Select the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] or [LETHAL HITS] ability. Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the selected ability. You can instead select the [SUSTAINED HITS 1], [LETHAL HITS] and [HAZARDOUS] abilities to apply to those weapons until the end of the phase.
stratagems.restrictions: You cannot target the same unit with the Experimental Ammunition and Threat Assessment Analyser Stratagems in the same phase.
stratagems.legend: The Earth caste have been experimenting with implanting AI neurochip-technology into hand-held scanners, enabling the swift calculation of precise firing solutions.

stratagems.name: WALL OF MIRRORS
stratagems.when: End of your opponent's Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One Stealth, Ghostkeel or Commander Shadowsun unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.
stratagems.restrictions: You cannot target a unit that is within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.legend: T'au Stealth Cadres utilise obfuscation fields and wide-band refraction beams to mask their advance.

stratagems.name: A TEMPTING TRAP
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One T'AU EMPIRE unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase. The first time you use this Stratagem, you must also select one objective marker that is not in your opponent's deployment zone; until the end of the battle, this becomes your Trap objective marker.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a ranged attack that targets an enemy unit within range of your Trap objective marker, add 1 to the Wound roll.
stratagems.restrictions: You cannot use this Stratagem during the first or second battle rounds.
stratagems.legend: Kauyon teaches that many things can be used to bait a trap, luring the foe into position.

stratagems.name: COORDINATE TO ENGAGE
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One T'AU EMPIRE unit from your army that has just been selected as an Observer unit (see For the Greater Good).
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets their Spotted unit, improve the Ballistic Skill characteristic of that attack by 1 and, if your unit has the Markerlight keyword, that attack has the [IGNORES COVER] ability.
stratagems.legend: T'au Hunter Cadres work in close coordination to destroy the most dangerous enemy targets.

stratagems.name: POINT-BLANK AMBUSH
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One T'AU EMPIRE unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a ranged attack that targets an enemy unit within 9", improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.
stratagems.restrictions: You cannot use this Stratagem during the first or second battle rounds.
stratagems.legend: Devastating firepower need not be applied from afar, especially when striking an unsuspecting foe.

stratagems.name: PHOTON GRENADES
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Charge phase, just after an enemy unit has declared a charge.
stratagems.target: One T'au Empire Grenades unit from your army that was selected as one of the targets of that charge.
stratagems.effect: That enemy unit must immediately take a Battle-shock test, and until the end of the phase, subtract 2 from Charge rolls made for that enemy unit.
stratagems.legend: Hurling a volley of photon grenades, the T'au leave their enemies dazzled and disorientated, unable to close the distance into combat at a crucial moment.

stratagems.name: COMBAT EMBARKATION
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Charge phase, just after an enemy unit has declared a charge.
stratagems.target: One T'au Empire Infantry unit from your army that was selected as one of the targets of that charge, and one friendly Transport.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can embark within that TRANSPORT. If it does, your opponent can select new targets for that charge.
stratagems.restrictions: Every model in your T'AU EMPIRE INFANTRY unit must be within 3" of that TRANSPORT and there must be sufficient transport capacity to embark the entire unit.
stratagems.legend: Those who act as the lure in the Kauyon must be ready to make a hasty withdrawal once the enemy closes into killing range, lest they be trapped.

stratagems.name: JOIN THE HUNT
stratagems.when: Any phase.
stratagems.target: One Kroot Infantry or Kroot Hounds unit from your army that was just destroyed. You can use this Stratagem on that unit even though it was just destroyed.
stratagems.effect: Add a new unit to your army identical to your destroyed unit, in Strategic Reserves, at its Starting Strength.
stratagems.restrictions: This Stratagem cannot be used to return destroyed Character units to Attached units. You can only use this Stratagem once per battle.
stratagems.legend: When a Kroot Hunting Pack closes in on its prey, there are often other hunters waiting to join in the fray and take their share of any spoils.

stratagems.name: A TRAP WELL LAID
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One Kroot unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: After your unit has resolved its attacks this phase, select one enemy unit that was hit by one or more of those attacks. Until the end of the phase, each time a KROOT model from your army makes an attack that targets that enemy unit, unless the attacking unit is Battle-shocked, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.
stratagems.legend: The Kroot have long perfected the art of ambush hunting, their packs working in deadly concert.

stratagems.name: THE GRISLY FEAST
stratagems.when: Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One Kroot unit from your army that destroyed one or more enemy units this phase.
stratagems.effect: In your opponent's next Command phase, each enemy unit within 6" of your unit must take a Battle-shock test. If the unit taking that test is Below Half-strength, subtract 1 from that test. Enemy units affected by this Stratagem do not need to take any other Battle-shock tests in the same phase.
stratagems.legend: The psychological impact of witnessing one's comrades being dismembered and devoured by gore-splattered Kroot cannot be overstated.

stratagems.name: GUERRILLA WARRIORS
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, just after a Kroot unit from your army Falls Back.
stratagems.target: That KROOT unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge.
stratagems.legend: Kroot see no value in stand-up fights, caring little for honour or glory. They hit and fade, frustrating their foes and bleeding them by degrees until - weakened and out of position - they are rendered vulnerable.

stratagems.name: HIDDEN HUNTERS
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One Kroot unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit can only be selected as the target of a ranged attack if the attacking model is within 18".
stratagems.legend: The Kroot are experts in camouflage and concealment, able to utilise cover in ways most foes would never consider and - to their great misfortune - do not anticipate.

stratagems.name: EMP GRENADES
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy VEHICLE unit is selected to shoot or fight.
stratagems.target: One Kroot Grenades unit from your army within 8" of that enemy VEHICLE unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, worsen the Weapon Skill and Ballistic Skill characteristics of that enemy VEHICLE unit's weapons by 1.
stratagems.legend: Furnished by T'au allies or returning Farstalkers, these electromagnetic grenades wreak havoc with the animuses of armoured fighting vehicles.

stratagems.name: BOARDING BLADES
stratagems.when: Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One KROOT unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in your unit by 1. In addition, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, on a Critical Wound, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by an additional 1.
stratagems.legend: Expecting close-quarters carnage, these Kroot have adapted the blades on their weapons to slice through even thick armour.

stratagems.name: BRUTE FORCE
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, just after a KROOTOX RIDERS unit from your army opens a Hatchway.
stratagems.target: That KROOTOX RIDERS unit.
stratagems.effect: Roll one D6 for each unit that is within 3" of that Hatchway, if that Hatchway is visible to that unit and that unit is wholly on the opposite side of it from your unit: on a 2-4, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound; on a 5+, that enemy unit suffers 2 mortal wounds.
stratagems.legend: Where cunning will not suffice, the brutal strength of Krootox sees hatchways and bulkheads smashed to pieces, filling the corridors beyond with whickering shrapnel.

stratagems.name: SWEEPING AMBUSH
stratagems.when: Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One KROOT unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a Pile-in or Consolidation move, it can move up to 6" instead of up to 3". In addition, when making a Consolidation move, that model can end that move within Engagement Range of the closest enemy unit that was not visible to its unit when it started that move.
stratagems.legend: Once they spring their ambush these Kroot move fast, hacking through one band of foes and pouncing on the next before the enemy can regain their footing.

stratagems.name: TANGLEBOMB BOLAS
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One KROOT unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit within 9" of and visible to your unit and roll one D6: on a 2+, until the start of your next Shooting phase, halve the Move characteristic of models in that enemy unit and halve Advance and Charge rolls made for it.
stratagems.legend: Sent spinning in to entangle their targets, these weapons leave their victims easy prey for the screeching Kroot.

stratagems.name: AGGRESSIVE MOBILITY
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One T'AU EMPIRE unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, if your unit Advances, do not make an Advance roll for it. Instead, until the end of the phase, add 6" to the Move characteristic of models in your unit.
stratagems.legend: By advancing swiftly into commanding positions, Mont'ka forces maximise the benefits of their enemies' shock and disorientation.

stratagems.name: PINPOINT COUNTER-OFFENSIVE
stratagems.when: Any phase.
stratagems.target: One T'AU EMPIRE unit (excluding Kroot units) from your army that was just destroyed. You can use this Stratagem on that unit even though it was just destroyed.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the battle, each time a T'AU EMPIRE unit (excluding KROOT units) from your army makes an attack that targets the enemy unit that just destroyed your unit, you can re-roll the Hit roll.
stratagems.legend: Mont'ka emphasises rapid evolving threat-analysis and the application of overwhelming firepower to eliminate emergent high-priority targets.

stratagems.name: FOCUSED FIRE
stratagems.when: Start of your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: Two T'AU EMPIRE units from your army that have not been selected to shoot this phase, and one enemy unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in either of your units makes an attack, it can only target that enemy unit (and only if it is an eligible target for that attack), and when resolving that attack, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic by 1.
stratagems.restrictions: You cannot use this Stratagem during the fourth or fifth battle rounds.
stratagems.legend: Mont'ka doctrine heavily emphasises the massed concentration of fire upon a single target at a time, obliterating each component of the enemy force in succession with a series of unrelenting barrages.

stratagems.name: COMBAT DEBARKATION
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One T'au Empire Infantry unit from your army that disembarked from a TRANSPORT this turn.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets the closest enemy unit, you can re-roll the Wound roll.
stratagems.legend: The most aggressive Fire caste warriors sometimes spring from moving transports, roll with the impact of landing, and come up with weapons already blazing.

stratagems.name: PULSE ONSLAUGHT
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One T'au Empire Infantry unit (excluding Kroot units) from your army that has just shot, and one enemy unit (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES) hit by one or more of those attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of your opponent's next turn, that enemy unit is shaken. While a unit is shaken, subtract 2 from its Move characteristic and subtract 2 from Advance and Charge rolls made for it.
stratagems.legend: Rather than charge into hand-to-hand combat, T'au soldiery instead intensify their fire patterns, pinning their advancing foes and staving off their onslaught.

stratagems.name: COUNTERFIRE DEFENCE SYSTEMS
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One T'AU EMPIRE unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack is allocated to your unit, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack.
stratagems.legend: Point-defence systems trigger as incoming fire is detected, blasting projectiles from the air and lessening the power of the enemy fusillade.

stratagems.name: THE ARRO'KON PROTOCOL
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One T'au Empire Battlesuit unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets an enemy unit that contains 6 or more models, that attack has the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability. If that attack targets an enemy unit that contains 11 or more models, it has the [SUSTAINED HITS 2] ability instead.
stratagems.legend: Commander Arro'kon's teachings are considered pre-eminent in the art of engaging and eliminating numerically overwhelming enemy formations.

stratagems.name: FAIL-SAFE DETONATOR
stratagems.when: Any phase, just after a T'au Empire Battlesuit model from your army is destroyed.
stratagems.target: That destroyed model's unit. You can use this Stratagem on that unit even if that unit was just destroyed.
stratagems.effect: Before removing your model from play, if it has the Deadly Demise ability, do not roll for that ability; instead, you can choose whether the result of that roll is a 1 or a 6. If your model does not have the Deadly Demise ability, roll one D6 for each unit within 6" of it: on a 4+, that unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.
stratagems.legend: Devices are incorporated into some battlesuits either to prevent high-ranking pilots being taken alive for interrogation or to prevent just such fatal explosions.

stratagems.name: THE SHORTENED BLADE
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One T'au Empire Battlesuit unit from your army that is arriving using the Deep Strike ability this phase.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can be set up anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 6" horizontally away from all enemy models.
stratagems.restrictions: A unit targeted with this Stratagem is not eligible to declare a charge in the same turn.
stratagems.legend: Made famous by Commander Farsight and his protege Brightsword, this philosophy encourages pilots to drop into the very teeth of the enemy army and apply their firepower at point-blank range.

stratagems.name: THE TORCHSTAR GAMBIT
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One T'au Empire Battlesuit unit from your army that can FLY whose attacks have been resolved this phase.
stratagems.effect: If your unit is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, it can make a Normal move. If it does, your unit cannot declare a charge this turn
stratagems.legend: Though now disgraced by association with O'Shovah, Sub-Commander Torchstar's strike-and-fade tactics are still taught - albeit officially under other names - in many Fire caste academies.

stratagems.name: GRAV-INHIBITOR FIELD
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Charge phase, just after an enemy unit has declared a charge.
stratagems.target: One T'au Empire Battlesuit unit from your army that was selected as a target of that charge.
stratagems.effect: That enemy unit must immediately take a Battle-shock test and you must roll one D6 for each model in that enemy unit: for each 6, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound.
stratagems.legend: First used by O'Jir during the battle for Laguna Shard, these battlesuit-mounted emitters batter advancing foes backwards with gravitic pulse waves.

stratagems.name: STIMM INJECTORS
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One T'au Empire Battlesuit unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 6+ ability.
stratagems.legend: On-board hypodermics shunt pain-blockers and chemical stimulants into the pilot's system.

stratagems.name: RESPONSIVE VOLLEY
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, just after a FIRE WARRIOR or PATHfINDER TEAM unit from your army opens a Hatchway.
stratagems.target: That FIRE WARRIOR or PATHFINDER TEAM unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, each time a model in your unit makes a ranged attack that targets an enemy unit wholly on the opposite side of that Hatchway from them, a Critical Hit is scored on an unmodified Hit roll of 5+, instead of only a 6.
stratagems.legend: Should enemy forces be suddenly revealed during such close-confines combat, Fire caste soldiery are trained to loose immediate, punishing firepower.

stratagems.name: PULSE BARRAGE
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Movement or Charge phase.
stratagems.target: One FIRE WARRIOR or PATHfINDER TEAM unit from your army that has not fired Overwatch this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack while firing Overwatch, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ is required to score a hit, instead of an unmodified 6.
stratagems.legend: The tight confines of voidship warfare funnel the enemy right into the waiting T'au guns.

stratagems.name: FIRING LINE
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit destroys a T'AU EMPIRE unit from your army.
stratagems.target: One FIRE WARRIOR or PATHfINDER TEAM unit from your army that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, has not fired Overwatch this turn and is within 9" of that enemy unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can shoot as if it were your Shooting phase, but when doing so, models in your unit can only target that enemy unit (and only if it is an eligible target) and, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ is required to score a hit.
stratagems.legend: Should the foe break through one line of Fire caste defence, the next is ready to push them back from vital sites aboard the contested ship.

stratagems.name: RETREATING FIRE
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One FIRE WARRIOR or PATHfINDER TEAM unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Fell Back.
stratagems.legend: Collapsing lines of infantry provide a defence in depth through the shipboard confines, allowing the enemy to overextend even as retreating T'au continue to pour fire into them.
